items.name: auto-editor
items.desc: CLI that automatically edits video and audio by cutting silence and dead space; loudness-based first pass, pace via margin options; prebuilt binaries; Nim, Unlicense.

items.name: Clipchamp
items.desc: Free video editor and video maker from Microsoft with a web app: edit video, audio and images from scratch or start from templates.

items.name: Donkey
items.desc: An open-source analog of CapCut: a fast video editor for short videos with similar UX; tracks, effects, export without a watermark.

items.name: ffmpeg-webCLI
items.desc: A video editor right in the browser on ffmpeg.wasm: trimming, encoding and video processing without uploading to a server; everything is computed locally on WebAssembly.

items.name: FunClip
items.desc: Open-source local video clipping tool: FunASR/Paraformer speech recognition with timestamps and speaker labels, LLM-assisted clip selection, SRT subtitles, Gradio UI; Python; MIT.

items.name: OpenChatCut
items.desc: Local-first open-source AI video editor: multitrack timeline, Remotion render, Agent Skills and MCP so Codex or Claude Code edits and exports real projects; Electron, React; AGPL-3.0.

items.name: OpenMontage
items.desc: open-source system that turns your AI coding assistant (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) into a whole video production studio

items.name: Openreel
items.desc: free open-source video editor that works right in the browser, with no program installation and without uploading video to the cloud

items.name: Palmier Pro
items.desc: free video editor for Mac, but with a twist: you can work together with an AI agent (Claude, Cursor, etc.) right on the timeline.

items.name: PreenCut
items.desc: Video cutting

items.name: Recordly
items.desc: beautiful screen recording with animations, no editing

items.name: Reelfolio
items.desc: Turn screenshots and screen recordings into polished portfolio showreels: 245+ motion styles, drag-and-drop editor, cloud render in 16:9, 9:16 and square; freemium.

items.name: Subtitle Edit
items.desc: Free subtitle editor: synchronization, OCR from hardsubs, translation, 300+ formats. Windows.

items.name: Video Editor
items.desc: video editor with an AI assistant via Remotion

items.name: WolfCut (Concat)
items.desc: Free open-source CapCut replacement: multi-track video editing, auto-subtitles (whisper locally), TTS, no watermark — Rust, fully offline, Win/macOS/Linux/Android.

items.name: Adobe After Effects 2025
items.desc: Professional motion design and visual effects (free, rutracker)

items.name: Awesome Piracy
items.desc: a collection of pirated content

items.name: Cliply
items.desc: Small desktop video downloader (macOS/Windows): YouTube/TikTok/Pinterest, MP3/M4A, trimming, playlists, download queue, yt-dlp auto-update. EN/RU.

items.name: cobalt
items.desc: Media downloader: paste a public link and get the file; self-hostable API and web UI, no ads or trackers; Node.js; AGPL-3.0.

items.name: ReClip
items.desc: Self-hosted video downloader with a clean web UI: yt-dlp under the hood → 1000+ sites, MP4/MP3, bulk download, quality selection. Flask, ~150 lines.

items.name: torlink
items.desc: program for searching and downloading torrents right from the terminal (command line), with no setup at all.

items.name: yoinks
items.desc: Terminal TUI video downloader from Pablo Stanley: yt-dlp under the hood → 1800+ sites, resolution choice or MP3, no ads or popups. npm i -g yoinks.

items.name: Youtube DL WPF
items.desc: a desktop app for downloading video and audio from YouTube and thousands of other sites (a wrapper over yt-dlp)

items.name: AnyDoc
items.desc: Open-source document parser from Firecrawl: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, images → markdown/structure via LLM. A replacement for proprietary parsers.

items.name: Docling
items.desc: Document parsing library: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, EPUB and images to Markdown/JSON with layout, tables and formulas; Python, pip; MIT.

items.name: ExifTool
items.desc: A legendary command-line utility for reading/writing/editing metadata (EXIF, IPTC, XMP) in photo, video and document files. A MUST-HAVE for photo OSINT.

items.name: Google LENS
items.desc: visual search tool: point your phone camera (or upload a photo) at anything

items.name: LiteParse
items.desc: Fast lightweight PDF parser: spatial text with bounding boxes via PDFium, pluggable OCR (bundled Tesseract or HTTP OCR servers), local run; pip install liteparse; Rust core; Apache-2.0.

items.name: Make Look Scanned
items.desc: Browser tool to make PDFs "look scanned": rotation, paper tone, grain, scanner blur, edge shadow, grayscale. All local, no upload. Multi-page, outputs flattened image-based PDF.

items.name: Marker
items.desc: Convert PDF to markdown and JSON quickly with high accuracy: layout-aware parsing of text, tables, equations and images, OCR support; Python; Apache-2.0.

items.name: olmOCR
items.desc: PDF and image documents converted to clean Markdown with a 7B vision-language model: equations, tables, handwriting, reading order, header/footer cleanup; GPU needed; Python; Apache-2.0.

items.name: PaddleOCR
items.desc: OCR toolkit and document AI engine: PDF and image pages to LLM-ready JSON/Markdown, PaddleOCR-VL 0.9B model, tables, formulas, layout models; pip install paddleocr; Python; Apache-2.0.

items.name: Unlimited-OCR
items.desc: Baidu open vision-language OCR model for one-shot long-horizon parsing of long documents, images and PDFs, multilingual; weights on Hugging Face and GitHub; MIT.

items.name: Devault ASCII
items.desc: Browser ASCII art generator: converts images and videos into ASCII, braille, halftone dots, dither or brick mosaics; runs client-side, free account to export without watermark.

items.name: SVG
items.desc: a huge pack of SVG images

items.name: compressO
items.desc: free program for compressing videos and images (for Windows/Mac/Linux). You drop in a heavy video file and get the same one back several times smaller, with minimal quality loss

items.name: HatchZip
items.desc: Archive extractor that unpacks huge zip/rar/7z/tar archives in place, shrinking the archive as files hatch, so only free space for the output is needed; CLI hz with right-click menu; MIT/Apache-2.0.
